question: Who taught CMPE 126 in Spring 2025?

question: What is the average grade point in MATH 454?

question: List the courses in the Biology department ordered by course code.

question: Give the english department's course titles sorted by code.

question: Who are the top 3 students by average grade in the English department?
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN grades g ON g.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE d.name = 'English' GROUP BY s.student_id ORDER BY AVG(g.points) DESC LIMIT 3

question: Name the 5 best students in computer engineering by average grade, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN grades g ON g.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE d.name = 'Computer Engineering' GROUP BY s.student_id ORDER BY AVG(g.points) DESC LIMIT 5

question: Which ENGL courses have never been offered?
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE subject = 'ENGL' AND course_id NOT IN (SELECT course_id FROM sections)

question: List the cmpe courses that have no sections.
gold_sql: SELECT title FROM courses WHERE subject = 'CMPE' AND course_id NOT IN (SELECT course_id FROM sections)

question: Which students in the History department have an average grade above the university average?
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN grades g ON g.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE d.name = 'History' GROUP BY s.student_id HAVING AVG(g.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM grades)

question: Who in english has an average grade higher than the overall average?
gold_sql: SELECT s.name FROM students s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_id = d.dept_id JOIN enrollments e ON e.student_id = s.student_id JOIN grades g ON g.enrollment_id = e.enrollment_id WHERE d.name = 'English' GROUP BY s.student_id HAVING AVG(g.points) > (SELECT AVG(points) FROM grades)
